questions.stem: The annual sales report will be released to shareholders _____ the end of the current fiscal year.
questions.explanation: The preposition 'at' or 'by' denotes a deadline or specific point in time; 'at the end of' is the standard idiomatic phrase.
questions.hint: Identify the standard preposition pairing with 'the end of'.

options.label: A
options.rationale: Correct idiom: 'at the end of [period]' specifies the point in time.

options.label: B
options.rationale: 'On' is used with specific days or dates, not 'the end of'.

options.label: C
options.rationale: 'Into' indicates movement or transformation, not a temporal point.

options.label: D
options.rationale: 'Among' denotes distribution within a group, not time.

groups.passage:
Notice to all building tenants:
The main elevators in the North Tower will be undergoing scheduled maintenance this Saturday, October 20, between 8:00 AM and 2:00 PM. During this period, please use the service elevator located near the rear entrance. We apologize for any inconvenience.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the notice?
questions.explanation: The notice informs tenants about elevator maintenance and alternative access.
questions.hint: Look at the first sentence of the notice for the main subject.

options.label: A
options.text: To announce elevator maintenance and alternative access
options.rationale: The notice explicitly details maintenance hours and directs tenants to the service elevator.

options.label: B
options.text: To notify tenants of a permanent building closure
options.rationale: The closure is temporary and applies only to main elevators on Saturday.

options.label: C
options.rationale: No job opening is mentioned in the text.

options.label: D
options.rationale: No meeting is mentioned in the text.
